A rendered Markdown document

Running text in a prose container reads at a line height of 1.65 and keeps to a reading measure of about sixty-eight characters, however wide the container is, so a reader's eye finds the start of the next line. It has a link, a link target with no href and inline code.

Lists

  • A list item is held to the reading measure too, like the paragraphs around it, so a long item wraps where the running text does.
  • A list item with a nested list:
    1. a nested item
    2. and another

A block quote

Tables and code blocks may use the full width of the container; running text keeps to about sixty-eight characters.
